# 🎉 Pixel Taskbar Enabler v1.1.0 (Release 3-1.1.0)
🇨🇴 🇪🇸 Ver Changelog en Español
Esta actualización de **Pixel Taskbar Enabler** trae opciones avanzadas para la vista de Recientes y mejoras clave en la ergonomía a una sola mano. ### ✨ Novedades * **Opciones de Burbujas:** Nueva configuración para cambiar la posición de descarte (arriba, abajo, izquierda, derecha, centro). * **Bubble Bottom Layout:** Nuevo diseño invertido que mueve las burbujas de recientes a la parte inferior para uso fácil a una sola mano. * **Escalado de Encabezados:** Controles independientes para escalar los encabezados en los modos Móvil y Grid (Tablet). * **Correcciones:** Posición inicial de las burbujas arreglada. Ajustes, instrucciones y traducciones actualizadas. ### ⚙️ Requisitos * **Google Pixel** (Android 17, firmware oficial). * Acceso **Root** (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch) y entorno **Xposed** activo (LSPosed, Zygisk, o Vector). *(Nota: Marca "System UI" en Xposed para habilitar las funciones de Burbujas).* ### 🛡️ Seguridad APK firmado y libre de malware. Puedes ignorar la advertencia de "App desconocida" de *Play Protect* (falso positivo habitual en módulos root). ✅ **[Ver análisis de VirusTotal (0 Detecciones)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/ff2bdc021cfb84c763d1c9a5714bc103f0ad85f9c700afbd2f65097dcc7298b6?nocache=1)** ### 📥 Instalación Instala `PixelTaskbarEnabler-3-1.1.0.apk`, abre la aplicación, configura tus preferencias y presiona **Aplicar Cambios**.
🇬🇧 🇺🇸 View Changelog in English
This update to **Pixel Taskbar Enabler** brings advanced customization for the Recents view and key improvements for one-handed ergonomics. ### ✨ What's New * **Bubble Options:** New setting to configure the dismiss position (top, bottom, left, right, center). * **Bubble Bottom Layout:** A new inverted design that moves recent bubbles to the bottom for easier one-handed use. * **Header Scaling:** Independent scale controls for headers in both Mobile and Grid (Tablet) modes. * **Fixes:** Initial bubble position fixed. Default settings, instructions, and translations updated. ### ⚙️ Requirements * **Google Pixel** (Android 17, official firmware). * **Root** access (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch) and an active **Xposed** environment (LSPosed, Zygisk, or Vector). *(Note: Check "System UI" in Xposed to enable Bubble features).* ### 🛡️ Security Signed, malware-free APK. Ignore *Play Protect*'s "Unknown app" warning during installation (standard root module false positive). ✅ **[View VirusTotal analysis (0 Detections)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/ff2bdc021cfb84c763d1c9a5714bc103f0ad85f9c700afbd2f65097dcc7298b6?nocache=1)** ### 📥 Installation Install `PixelTaskbarEnabler-3-1.1.0.apk`, open the app, configure your preferences, and press **Apply Changes**.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/beymans-code/pixel-taskbar-enabler/compare/2-1.0.1...3-1.1.0

# 🎉 Pixel Taskbar Enabler v1.0.1 (Release 2-1.0.1)
🇨🇴 🇪🇸 Ver Changelog en Español
En esta nueva actualización de **Pixel Taskbar Enabler** se ha rediseñado la interfaz, se han incorporado nuevas funcionalidades y se ha mejorado la estabilidad general del módulo. ### ✨ Novedades y Mejoras * **Rediseño de Interfaz:** Se incorpora una nueva barra de navegación inferior (Navbar) para facilitar la transición entre ajustes, presentando un aspecto visual más limpio y estructurado. * **Escalado del Taskbar:** Se añade la opción para ajustar el tamaño general de la barra de tareas de manera independiente. * **Optimización del Dock:** El ajuste de cantidad máxima de aplicaciones ahora se aplica *exclusivamente* a la barra de tareas, evitando así conflictos con el launcher del sistema. * **Limpieza de Código:** Se ha eliminado la función de escalado individual de iconos debido a que presentaba errores (bugs) y resultaba innecesaria tras la implementación del escalado general de la barra de tareas. * **Soporte Multi-Idioma:** Se han integrado y corregido las traducciones al español correspondientes a las nuevas configuraciones. ### ⚙️ Requisitos y Compatibilidad * Dispositivo **Google Pixel** (probado en firmware oficial). * Compatibilidad probada en **Android 17**. * Requiere acceso **Root** (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). * Entorno **Xposed** activo (LSPosed, Zygisk, o Vector). ### 🛡️ Seguridad y Play Protect Este APK ha sido firmado oficialmente y analizado en busca de malware. Debido a la naturaleza de los módulos Root independientes, es posible que *Google Play Protect* emita una advertencia de "App desconocida". Este comportamiento representa un falso positivo habitual, por lo que es seguro seleccionar la opción de "Instalar de todas formas". ✅ **[Ver análisis de VirusTotal (0 Detecciones)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/33045295199bd03fec359ddb8199bbbbebbcf8286fabdde1ed075bc2814e371a?nocache=1)** ### 📥 Instalación y Actualización 1. Descargue el archivo `PixelTaskbarEnabler-2-1.0.1.apk` adjunto a esta publicación. 2. Proceda con la instalación (puede instalarse directamente como actualización sobre la versión anterior). 3. Abra la aplicación "Pixel Taskbar Enabler", configure las nuevas opciones de escalado según su preferencia y presione **Aplicar Cambios**. --- *Desarrollado para la comunidad de Android.*
🇬🇧 🇺🇸 View Changelog in English
In this new update of **Pixel Taskbar Enabler**, the interface has been redesigned, new features have been incorporated, and the general stability of the module has been improved. ### ✨ What's New & Improvements * **Interface Redesign:** A new bottom navigation bar (Navbar) is incorporated to facilitate transitioning between settings, presenting a cleaner and more structured visual appearance. * **Taskbar Scaling:** The option to adjust the overall size of the taskbar independently is added. * **Dock Optimization:** The maximum application count setting is now applied *exclusively* to the taskbar, avoiding conflicts with the system launcher. * **Code Cleanup:** The individual icon scaling feature has been removed due to bugs and because it became unnecessary after implementing the overall taskbar scaling. * **Multi-Language Support:** Spanish translations for the new configurations have been integrated and corrected. ### ⚙️ Requirements & Compatibility * **Google Pixel** device (tested on official firmware). * Compatibility tested on **Android 17**. * **Root** access required (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). * Active **Xposed** environment (LSPosed, Zygisk, or Vector). ### 🛡️ Security & Play Protect This APK has been officially signed and analyzed for malware. Due to the nature of independent Root modules, *Google Play Protect* might issue an "Unknown app" warning. This behavior is a common false positive, so it is safe to select "Install anyway". ✅ **[View VirusTotal analysis (0 Detections)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/33045295199bd03fec359ddb8199bbbbebbcf8286fabdde1ed075bc2814e371a?nocache=1)** ### 📥 Installation & Update 1. Download the attached `PixelTaskbarEnabler-2-1.0.1.apk` file below. 2. Proceed with the installation (can be installed directly as an update over the previous version). 3. Open the "Pixel Taskbar Enabler" app, configure the new scaling options to your preference, and press **Apply Changes**. --- *Made with ♥ for the Android community.*

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/beymans-code/pixel-taskbar-enabler/compare/v1.0.0...2-1.0.1

# 🎉 Pixel Taskbar Enabler v1.0.0 (Initial Release)
🇨🇴 🇪🇸 Ver Changelog en Español
¡Bienvenido a la primera versión oficial estable de **Pixel Taskbar Enabler**! 🚀 Este módulo Xposed ha sido diseñado para traerte la barra de tareas (Taskbar) oculta de las tablets directamente a tu teléfono Google Pixel, de forma limpia, sin necesidad de alterar los DPI del sistema y sin causar errores visuales. ### ✨ Características Principales * **Activación Nativa:** Desbloquea la Taskbar oculta directamente en el código del Pixel Launcher original. * **Escalado Personalizado:** Ajusta el tamaño de los iconos y carpetas a tu gusto para que encajen perfectos en la pantalla de tu móvil. * **Dock Extendido:** Controla el número máximo de iconos permitidos en la barra inferior. * **Recientes Clásicos:** Fuerza al sistema a mantener la vista de "Aplicaciones recientes" normal de los teléfonos, evitando la molesta interfaz gigante pensada para tablets. ### ⚙️ Requisitos y Compatibilidad * Dispositivo **Google Pixel** (probado en firmware oficial). * Probado en **Android 17**. * Requiere acceso **Root** (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). * Entorno **Xposed** activo (LSPosed, Zygisk, o Vector). ### 🛡️ Seguridad y Play Protect Este APK ha sido firmado oficialmente y analizado en busca de malware. Al ser un módulo Root independiente, es muy común que *Google Play Protect* muestre una advertencia de "App desconocida" o la intente bloquear. **Esto es un falso positivo normal** y puedes darle a "Instalar de todas formas". ✅ **[Ver análisis de VirusTotal (0 Detecciones)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/7e51bab3b19012ea41728ba714e2daf9c62b45854359c3dea3fd7124aea6b9ae/detection)** ### 📥 Instalación Rápida 1. Descarga el archivo `PixelTaskbarEnabler-v1.0.0.apk` adjunto aquí abajo. 2. Instálalo en tu dispositivo Android. 3. Activa el módulo en tu gestor de Xposed (ej. LSPosed Manager) y asegúrate de marcar **Pixel Launcher** en la lista de apps. 4. Abre la aplicación "Pixel Taskbar Enabler", ajusta las opciones y presiona **Aplicar Cambios** (esto reiniciará tu pantalla de inicio automáticamente). --- *Hecho con ♥ para la comunidad de Android.*
🇬🇧 🇺🇸 View Changelog in English
Welcome to the first official stable release of **Pixel Taskbar Enabler**! 🚀 This Xposed module is designed to bring the hidden tablet Taskbar directly to your Google Pixel phone, cleanly, without needing to alter the system DPI and without causing visual bugs. ### ✨ Main Features * **Native Activation:** Unlocks the hidden Taskbar directly within the original Pixel Launcher code. * **Custom Scaling:** Adjust the size of icons and folders to your liking so they fit perfectly on your mobile screen. * **Extended Dock:** Control the maximum number of icons allowed on the bottom bar. * **Classic Recents:** Forces the system to keep the normal phone "Recent apps" view, avoiding the annoying giant interface designed for tablets. ### ⚙️ Requirements & Compatibility * **Google Pixel** device (tested on official firmware). * Tested on **Android 17**. * Requires **Root** access (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). * Active **Xposed** environment (LSPosed, Zygisk, or Vector). ### 🛡️ Security & Play Protect This APK has been officially signed and analyzed for malware. Being an independent Root module, it is very common for *Google Play Protect* to show an "Unknown app" warning or attempt to block it. **This is a normal false positive**, and you can simply tap "Install anyway". ✅ **[View VirusTotal Analysis (0 Detections)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/7e51bab3b19012ea41728ba714e2daf9c62b45854359c3dea3fd7124aea6b9ae/detection)** ### 📥 Quick Installation 1. Download the `PixelTaskbarEnabler-v1.0.0.apk` file attached below. 2. Install it on your Android device. 3. Enable the module in your Xposed manager (e.g., LSPosed Manager) and make sure to check **Pixel Launcher** in the app list. 4. Open the "Pixel Taskbar Enabler" app, adjust the settings, and press **Apply Changes** (this will restart your home screen automatically). --- *Made with ♥ for the Android community.*

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/beymans-code/pixel-taskbar-enabler/commits/v1.0.0

🇬🇧 - 🇺🇸 English Version ### Introduction Pixel Taskbar Enabler is an **exclusive Xposed / LSPosed / Vector module** designed to force the appearance and customize the taskbar in the native Pixel Launcher of Google Pixel devices. It brings the tablet experience to your device without needing to modify the system DPI. Because it uses Xposed, changes are applied in memory, making them non-destructive and easily reversible just by disabling the module and restarting the device. > *I hope that at some point Google decides to officially incorporate these customization options into the native Pixel Launcher. In the meantime, this project will remain alive as long as possible—provided Google doesn't decide to turn Android into a completely closed system.* --- ### Features * **Taskbar Activation:** Forces the appearance of the Pixel Launcher taskbar on your mobile device. * **Icon and Folder Scaling:** Adjust the size of the icons in the taskbar and the app grid. * **Icon Count:** Control how many apps you want to display simultaneously on the bottom dock. * **Mobile-style Recents:** Forces the system to show the "Recent Apps" view with the classic phone style, even when the interface is simulating a tablet. --- ### Compatibility This module is designed and tested exclusively for the **Pixel Launcher** on official Google Pixel firmware. Compatible with **Android 17**. > [!WARNING] > Its functionality is not guaranteed on custom ROMs (LineageOS, Pixel Experience, etc.) or third-party launchers (Nova, Lawnchair, etc.). > [!TIP] > This module requires an installation of Magisk or KernelSU and an Xposed, LSPosed or Vector environment with Zygisk enabled. --- ### 🛡️ Security and Play Protect Warning Since this application requests special permissions to modify internal system functions via Xposed, it is very common for **Google Play Protect** to flag it as an "Unknown app" or block it when trying to install. This is a standard false positive for root modules outside the Play Store. ✅ **This application is 100% safe and open source.** - It does not collect data, does not connect to the internet, and all the code is publicly available here for review. - You can verify the APK analysis on **[VirusTotal (0 Detections)](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/16e29ec671490824612686adcc6aad08b94db30f8dad8bb6c67f261c3d1cf03c?nocache=1)**. > If Play Protect blocks the installation, click on **"Learn more"** and then **"Install anyway"**. --- ### Installation 1. Download the latest **APK** from the [Releases](https://github.com/beymans-code/pixel-taskbar-enabler/releases) page. 2. Install the module on your device. 3. Open your **Xposed Manager**. 4. Go to the "Modules" tab and enable **Pixel Taskbar Enabler**. 5. Ensure that **Pixel Launcher** is checked in the target applications list. 6. Open your root manager (such as **KernelSU**, **Magisk**, or **APatch**) and grant superuser permissions to **Pixel Taskbar Enabler**. This allows the app to restart the Pixel Launcher automatically whenever you apply changes *(otherwise, you will have to manually force stop the Pixel Launcher app via System Settings)*. 7. Open Pixel Taskbar Enabler, adjust the options to your liking, and tap **Apply Changes**. --- ### Downloads | Channel | Source | | :--- | :--- | | **Stable Versions** | [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/beymans-code/pixel-taskbar-enabler/releases) | --- ### Issues and Bug Reports If you experience any issues, find a bug, or have suggestions for new features, please report them in the original repository: | Action | Link | | :--- | :--- | | **Report a Bug or Request a Feature** | [GitHub Issues Section](https://github.com/beymans-code/pixel-taskbar-enabler/issues) | --- ### Credits and Acknowledgements This project is possible thanks to the following open-source contributions and teams: * [PixelXpert / AOSPMods](https://github.com/siavash79/PixelXpert): Original team (@siavash79 & @ElTifo) from where inspiration and base code were taken. * [XposedBridge](https://github.com/rovo89/XposedBridge): The original creation of Xposed by @rovo89. * [LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed): The LSPosed team for keeping the environment alive. * [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector): The Vector team for keeping the environment alive. * **Google & Android:** The Android operating system and the Google team. --- ### License Pixel Taskbar Enabler is licensed under the [GNU General Public License v3](http://www.gnu.org/copyleft/gpl.html).
